overview.title: PRODUCT OVERVIEW
overview.body: F4+ is the higher-capacity version of the compact F4 platform, pairing a 2500 W rear hub motor with a 48V 20Ah ternary-lithium battery, front and rear disc brakes and a 25 kg kerb weight.
